inherits.meaning: all v8 constraints are retained; v12 preserves v11's sound Bool-only prepass while memoizing free-constant sort classification per build

scope.normalization_status: explicit exact-n15 finite slice; not a universal-target consequence

boolean_relaxation.include_criterion: every free uninterpreted constant has Bool sort
boolean_relaxation.exclude_criterion: at least one free uninterpreted constant has Real, Int, or another non-Bool sort
boolean_relaxation.soundness: the relaxation is a literal subset of v8 assertions
boolean_relaxation.classifier: one context-local memo per build, keyed by Z3 AST id; each unique subtree is traversed once and its free-constant sort data is reused for inclusion and excluded-sort audit
boolean_relaxation.classifier_compatibility: same individual-assertion selection and excluded-sort counting as v11 z3.z3util.get_vars; no global or cross-context cache
boolean_relaxation.loop: SAT model -> mine one v9 full-shell unique-possible-matching cut -> independently replay and assert into both Boolean and full solvers -> repeat
boolean_relaxation.timeout_or_budget: nonterminal; proceed to full solver with already admitted cuts
boolean_relaxation.unsat_gate: report full-case UNSAT only when every learned cut is theorem-sound and provenance-complete

cut_admission.criterion: all 120 permutations enumerated; exactly one avoids forced-zero cells; its five entries are certified nonzero
cut_admission.formula_binding: resolve every named row against the exact Encoding, validate row kinds and every indexed cell/point, reconstruct Not(And(activations, certified nonzeros, forced zeros)), require exact sexpr equality, and recompute its SHA-256
cut_admission.sexpr_hash_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of reconstructed_cut.sexpr() with no added newline

first_check_invariant.requirement: every Boolean-prepass learned cut is asserted into the full v8 solver before its first check

worker_provenance_gate.comparison: exact equality after recomputing target, schema version, v12/v8/v9/schema/uv.lock hashes, and the complete source contract
worker_provenance_gate.miner_hash: admissions must use the miner_v9_script_sha256 accepted by this gate

matrix.complete: the returned case multiset is exact and unknown=0 and error=0

retry.source: an exact-current schema-v8 summary for the same target with complete v8 frozen provenance
retry.byte_binding: read once; parse and SHA-256 the same byte string

artifacts.boolean_prepass.json: filter counts, budgets, checks, models, terminal reason, and initial/final Boolean formula hashes
artifacts.boolean_encoding.smt2.gz: replayable final Boolean formula after every admitted prepass cut
artifacts.power_cuts_v12.json: all learned cuts, admissions, source-model falsification, hashes, and phase counts
artifacts.encoding.smt2.gz: full formula including all learned cuts
artifacts.result.json: case verdict, provenance, counts, hashes, and artifact hashes

trust_boundary: external Z3 evidence for the exact-n15 finite encoding; not by itself a Lean theorem or universal closure
